ticket.message: My new password keeps getting rejected when I try to set it. What does a CloudDesk password need to have?

answer:
CD-10401: Hello,

Thank you for reaching out regarding your issue with setting a new password on CloudDesk. To ensure your password meets the necessary criteria, here’s what it should include:

- At least 8 characters long.
- Contains at least one uppercase letter.
- Contains at least one lowercase letter.
- Contains at least one number.
- Must be different from the previous password.

Please make sure your new password adheres to these guidelines before attempting to set it. If you continue to face issues, feel free to reach out to our support team for further assistance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]  
CloudDesk Support Agent
